territorialOutcomes.description: 15 common-regime or partial calculation paths plus four explicit unsupported-territory outcomes

validatedHouseholdProfiles.description: Valid combinations of 1–3 adults, six marital states, three filing preferences, 0–6 dependants and single-parent status after eligibility gates

incomeProfiles.description: Employment profile, gross-income band, self-employment band and pension/benefit profile

fiscalModifierProfiles.description: Housing tenure, capital-income band, disability band and input-quality state

scenarioBundles.description: Reference only, reference plus one comparison, or reference plus two comparisons

interpretation: This is the number of addressable deterministic calculation or structured-validation states under the published discretisation. It is not a count of stored people, database rows, legal constants, AI weights or precomputed results.
privacy: No state is precomputed from or linked to a real person. Household requests are calculated ephemerally.
